Distribution License Agreement
1.1 Licensor grants Distributor the distribution rights for the products, territory, permitted channels, and customer class specified in Schedule A. The exclusivity status and any right to sublicense are also as specified in Schedule A.
1.2 No rights beyond those expressly listed in Schedule A are granted.
1.3 The copy provided for review contains Sections 1 through 3; Schedule A is not attached.
